entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compiler doesn't report an error for dynamic evaluation of `&&`/`||` when left operand is statically typed as an interface with `true`/`false` operator. #80954
  • C# null-coalescing operators (??=) - silently fail on dictionary #80953
  • Add .NET 10 enum in `ReferenceAssemblies.Net` ahead of next month's release #80950
  • "Extract Interface" code fix priority too high on interfaces #80949

Closed

  • `BoundBinaryOperator.Method` is not a binary operator symbol for node created by `BindDynamicBinaryOperator` #78628
    Backlog
  • Eliminate dead parameters in flow analysis #42022
  • `csc` misinterprets a source file in root directory on Unix as a command-line option switch #80865
    18.3
  • Stack overflow in `ErrorFacts.IsBuildOnlyDiagnostic` #80840
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Add support for lineFoldingOnly folding ranges #80955
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Experiment: Enable LSP go-to-definition and find-all-references with command handler precedence #80951
  • Fix build task custom compiler logic #80948
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Cleanup usage of BoundBinaryOperator.Method API #80942
    Area-Compilers
  • Clarify BoundBinaryPattern.Disjunction #80918
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Next
  • Fix issue with when a CR/LF split occurs at a SubText's underlying span start #80911
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Remove some unused AbstractFlowPass parameters #80931
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix issue when caching CompilationWithAnalyzers against ProjectState instead of a project #80922
  • Fix csc/vbc misinterpretation of source files in root directory on Unix #80866
    Next
  • Avoid deep recursion for nested bound patterns #80920
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching, Next

Updated

  • Improve documentation and error message for InsertTokensBefore/After and ReplaceToken methods #80691
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error recovery for => in constructor initializers #80764
    Area-Compilers
  • Unify warnAsError build option between Unix and Windows #80916
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix IsSymbolAccessibleWithin to respect EmbeddedAttribute #80681
  • Extensions: improve diagnostics for operators #80928
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Add support for HandleAsyncEntryPoint API in async Main code generation #80939
  • Fix bad jump from yield break inside catch in async-iterator #80927
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Async Streams
  • fix: Add check before show signature help #80945
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix XAML peek in VS editor. XamlPeekableItemFactory needs to implement exported interface. #80923
  • Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #80859
    Area-Compilers
  • Add documentation for Sequence Points design #80943
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Add ParameterListStructureProvider for collapsing multi-line parameter lists #80944
    VSCode
  • Add snap script #80591
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Decouple synthesized top-level types tracking from PrivateImplementationDetails #80936
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
